title: affaan-m/ECC
claim: affaan-m/ECC — The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development f
why_good: A personal 'agent harness' bundling skills, memory and security patterns — useful as a reference, but it reads as one dev's setup, not a product.
value: Only becomes a business if it turns into a managed, opinionated agent-runtime teams standardize on; today it's a config repo.
risk: No clear buyer or moat yet, and harness patterns are being absorbed by the agent frameworks (LangGraph, Claude Code) themselves.

zh.claim: affaan-m/ECC —— agent harness 的性能优化系统:技能、直觉、记忆、安全、research-first 开发。
zh.why_good: 一套个人的「agent harness」,打包了技能/记忆/安全范式——作为参考有用,但更像某个开发者的个人配置,不是产品。
zh.value: 只有当它变成团队愿意统一采用的、有主见的托管 agent 运行时,才算生意;现在只是个配置仓库。
zh.risk: 还没有清晰的买家或护城河;harness 范式正被 agent 框架(LangGraph、Claude Code)本身吸收。
